enunciado: Implement a hash table of capacity 11 with parallel arrays keys/values/used and hash function h(k) = k % 11. Collisions are resolved with linear probing. Insert the keys 22, 33, 5, 16, 44 with their values, show how many probes each needed and look up 33, 16 and 7.
objetivos: Implement open addressing with linear probing
pistas: 22, 33 and 44 all land at position 0: collision.
If the slot is taken try the next one: (p + 1) % CAP.
The search stops when it finds the key or an empty slot.
